name: Fillion's Mission

angles.text: As a Mage, you can appreciate the delicate magical calculations needed to guide skycutter vessels through planar turbulence.
As one of the Skyborne, you know the struggle to establish safe routes between Skywall and Azeroth amid factional discord.

faq.answer: Fillion is an emissary or scout sent by the Supreme Magister to measure elemental currents at the Overlook Standing Stones. After an adventurer rescues him, he is too weak to finish the work.
Elaadrin Evengale is the Supreme Magister in Valanaar. He directs efforts to navigate the elemental plane safely and recover planar data for travel between Skywall and Azeroth.
faq.q: Who is Supreme Magister Elaadrin Evengale?

faq.answer: The readings track elemental currents at the Overlook Standing Stones. They are needed to calculate safe courses for skycutters through the elemental plane to Azeroth.
faq.q: Why was Fillion's data so important?

faq.answer: The Windshapers are a faction reported to have found their own way through the planes. Supreme Magister Evengale says they guard it out of dogmatic hubris instead of sharing it for the wider good of their people.
Skycutters are vessels made to fly through the elemental planes. They need precise readings of elemental currents to travel between Skywall and Azeroth safely.
The Al'Aketh are a faction Supreme Magister Evengale regards with disdain. He compares the Windshapers' selfish, dogmatic conduct to theirs.

sections.body: Fillion went to the Overlook Standing Stones to measure elemental currents. Those readings are needed to calculate safe courses for skycutter vessels between Skywall and Azeroth. After an ordeal that required his rescue, he is too wounded to finish the work. The vital data is presumed lost, so he sends his rescuer to report to the Supreme Magister.
sections.title: A Perilous Assignment

sections.body: In Valanaar, Supreme Magister Elaadrin Evengale is relieved to hear that Fillion survived, though the research is lost. Without reliable readings, safe routes across the Elemental Plane will be hard to open. Reports say the rival Windshapers have found their own way through the planes. They refuse to share it, putting factional secrecy before the welfare of all.
sections.title: Planar Strife in Valanaar

summary: Fillion lies wounded after his survey at the Overlook Standing Stones. The readings meant to guide skycutters between Skywall and Azeroth are presumed lost.
